results.detail: Fresh domain-3 nonce, live TSS ticket, exact selected device, and userspace USB transport produced INSTALL SUCCESS.
Link and Control remained registered at durable MCM-backed application paths after the runtime rebuild.
Runtime Manager, Control, Link, PreferenceLoader, and the measured tweak set were verified against the retained session checklist.
SpringBoard/menu/server behavior passed; the backboardd hook was rejected and quarantined without killing backboardd.

limitations: This retained session did not validate the replacement root-owned Intel package produced after the pre.10 permission defect.
No device identifier, pairing record, private key, nonce value, or ticket is retained in this public record.
Other device models and OS builds still require exact capability and compatibility checks.
